concept: ElastiCache Redis Multi-AZ + lazy loading: HA cache
tests: Choosing a cache engine with replication and automatic failover plus a caching strategy (choose two).
expected: ElastiCache for Redis with Multi-AZ (automatic failover) + lazy loading (cache-aside). Triggers: "repeatedly queries same data", "microsecond reads", "HA and automatic failover for the cache".
why_not: Memcached has no replication or failover — not HA; Redshift is OLAP, not an application cache.
